notes: No transmitter chain: the report is a letter and the Imam's written reply; Husayn b. Sa'id is the asker and not a link (rule 5)
The Imam is named in the report's words («إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا»): imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
